overview.title: Start with the conditions at both addresses.
overview.body: Useful location planning begins with the real route into each property. Entrances, shared spaces, loading positions and room priorities all influence the sequence without requiring invented local claims.

highlights.text: Review entry points and shared access before arrival
Coordinate loading space with the agreed moving window
Keep room labels connected to the destination handoff

services.intro: These routes demonstrate useful navigation without creating hard CMS relations.

localDetails.title: Operational details worth resolving early.
localDetails.body: The most useful local content explains what needs coordination. It does not rely on fabricated rules, maps or claims.

items.title: Building entry
items.description: Confirm which entrance supports the safest and clearest route for furniture and boxes.

items.title: Loading coordination
items.description: Agree where loading and unloading can happen within the planned arrival window.

items.description: Identify lifts, stairs and common areas that affect the order of movement.
